_doc: Stateful clusters for Phase 3 order-permutation testing. members are regexes over
control ids. reset: how state is wound back between orderings (reload = page reload
+ storage reset; remount = tab-switch away and back - the reset the app itself
performs). Clusters marked remountSensitive run each ordering BOTH ways.
Seeded from the 2026-07-28 exploration; Phase 3 refines members against controls.json.

clusters.note: workspace lock affects EVERY page's GridStack
drawer state survives navigation - only reload resets
preset x drag x save/load; preset button never reconciled with drag/Load (pre-spotted)
order-type x auto-refresh(sticky pause) x ticker(quasi) x tp/sl mode x ladder x recall
selection falls back to inbox[0] silently
period x q x tabs x page/perPage - perPage reset is inline, not in the reset effect (pre-spotted asymmetry)
backfill job handle is page-level - leaving the PAGE loses it while the server job runs (pre-spotted)
model tabs are data-dependent (named after live models)
facet->search->sort pipeline; state resets on remount (documented behavior worth asserting)
